title: kbgit.py publish with its safety refusals
goal: kbpublic.cmd_publish, after projecting and before pushing, checks that the source commit's integration CI verdict is ok (ql_deliver.ci_pipeline), that the projection's tree has no internal root and no _private/ or _cache/ path, and that the files it changes against the public tip have no leak-scan hit; each refusal exits 1 naming its cause and pushes nothing, and --dry-run reports the same; TestPublishSafety in _tools/test_kbpublic.py plants a red, a pending and an unreadable CI verdict (a stubbed run), an internal root, a _private file and a leaked address
notes: Existing refusals exit 1 (kbpublic.py docstring), so the new ones do too.
